feature_assessment.summary: 修复 fully-async completed group 丢失、partial continuation token budget、rollout temperature 与 rollout id 语义，并重构 rollout 组织结构。
修复 PPO raw KL 日志、dual-clip epsilon、OPD teacher temperature、CP 所属 DP group 的 advantage whiten 与本地 sample 配对。
修复 checkpoint step 恢复、最新版 Megatron 转换、全零 block FP8、eval-only optimizer/scheduler 以及 eval defaults 数据集覆盖语义。
新增 GLM-5 Megatron DeepEP 训练与 SGLang rollout 的确定性/逐层对齐能力及配套 patch、测试和依赖构建步骤。
引入统一 accelerator 抽象并新增 MUSA 支持；NPU 后端补丁必须针对新抽象重做，旧零散 CUDA/NPU 分支不能直接沿用。
logging、metric、profile、trace、rollout/train data 等模块迁入 observability，并修复 MTP 多头 loss logging；相关 UT 路径需要迁移。
修复 IPv6 distributed init、外部 engine debug_rollout_only placement group、设备 ID 数值排序等分布式行为。
修复 sandbox exec lock、混合多模态 filter 顺序、负数 dataset slice、Qwen3 连续 tool response 与 tau-bench token delta。
SGLang 与 Megatron 基线未变，但 Docker 构建新增固定 FlashQLA、TMS、DeepGEMM、DeepEP 和确定性对齐补丁；定制 sglang-router 断言仍为必需契约。
目标共有 97 个 test_*.py；区间内新增 28、修改 19、删除 6，并有 2 项重命名及 GPU CI 配置变化。v0.3.1 通过清单必须按 v0.3.2 路径与接口重新转换。

docker/Dockerfile: # The SGLang base image may include FA4.  The validated TE 2.16 CP stack uses
RUN pip uninstall -y flash-attn-4 flash_attn_4 || true
cd flash-attention/ && git checkout 002cce0a1068f8c07dfccb5a1d232b9a3276947c && git submodule update --init && \
# FlashQLA: optional GDN backend for Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next (--qwen-gdn-backend flashqla; requires SM90+)
(cd /root && git clone -b feat/v350_plus_8045 https://github.com/fzyzcjy/triton.git && cd triton && pip install -r python/requirements.txt && pip install --verbose -e .); \
# Temporarily install another sgl-kernel version for GB300 without rebuilding the whole image
# Megatron currently requires NumPy 1.x, while SciPy 1.18+ requires NumPy 2.x.
RUN python -c "import sglang_router; assert 'slime' in sglang_router.__version__"
# TODO temporarily skip patching for GB200/GB300 (and require users to bring their own sglang version). should add back later.
for patch in sglang.patch sglang-top_p.patch sglang-release_hicache.patch sglang-pull_weights.patch; do \
echo "Patch $patch does not apply to the SGLang source in the base image."; \
requirements.txt: memray  # needed for debugging (but is lightweight), we can put it to dev mode when using pyproject.toml

docker/Dockerfile: # SGLang instead of replacing its Blackwell inference kernels with FA2.
cd flash-attention/ && git checkout 002cce0a1068f8c07dfccb5a1d232b9a3276947c && git submodule update --init && \
# FlashQLA currently requires TileLang 0.1.9, while SGLang 0.5.15.post1 on
# the default FLA backend on CUDA 13 instead of downgrading SGLang's runtime.
# The cu13 TE wheel is built against a newer cuBLAS than SGLang's CUDA 13.0
# zhuzilin fork builds, grouped together right after Megatron-LM:
# torch_memory_saver, plus the GLM-5 train/rollout alignment kernels
# DeepGEMM's batch-invariant kernel selection; build the SGLang-compatible wheel.
# Megatron currently requires NumPy 1.x, while SciPy 1.18+ requires NumPy 2.x.
RUN python -c "import sglang_router; assert 'slime' in sglang_router.__version__"
echo "megatron-sglang-aligned.patch failed to apply cleanly. Please resolve conflicts." && \
# TODO temporarily skip patching for GB200/GB300 (and require users to bring their own sglang version). should add back later.
for patch in sglang.patch sglang-top_p.patch sglang-release_hicache.patch sglang-pull_weights.patch sglang-deterministic.patch; do \
echo "Patch $patch does not apply to the SGLang source in the base image."; \
requirements.txt: memray  # needed for debugging (but is lightweight), we can put it to dev mode when using pyproject.toml
